review_candidates.description: XL Pro Staffing & Consulting is seeking an IT Support & Network Administrator to provide hands-on technology support across our office locations. This position will be responsible for supporting employees, troubleshooting computers and office technology, maintaining network equipment, assisting with technology installations, and helping keep our day-to-day IT operations running smoothly. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems and isn't afraid to encounter something they haven't seen before. You don't need to know every answer—you need the technical foundation, curiosity, and initiative to find the answer and follow issues through to resolution . Key Responsibilities Help Desk & Employee Support Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to XL Pro employees. Troubleshoot Windows computers, software, connectivity, login, and account issues. Support Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Install approved software, applications, drivers, and updates. Troubleshoot printers, monitors, docking stations, and other office technology. Provide remote and onsite support as needed. Document solutions and recurring technical issues. Network & Office Technology Maintain and troubleshoot office network equipment, including TP-Link Omada equipment, managed switches, wireless access points, and network connections. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, switch-port, and basic VLAN issues. Install or replace network equipment and assist with network racks and cabling. Coordinate with internet providers, cabling contractors, and technology vendors when necessary. Computers & Hardware Diagnose laptop and desktop hardware issues. Set up, reset, reimage, repair, and prepare computers for employees. Troubleshoot hardware, software, peripherals, and device drivers. Assist with employee technology setup and equipment returns. Maintain and track company IT equipment and assets. Microsoft 365 Support Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft 365. Assist employees with Outlook, Teams, Microsoft Authenticator, MFA, and account issues. Perform authorized basic user administration, license assignments, security-group changes, and mailbox troubleshooting. Onsite & Field IT Support Travel to XL Pro offices and client locations when hands-on technical support is required. Install and troubleshoot computers, printers, network equipment, and other office technology. Install and support company-approved network-connected timekeeping devices at client locations. Assist with office technology moves, upgrades, and new deployments. Cybersecurity & Documentation Follow company cybersecurity and least-privilege practices. Verify required endpoint-security applications are operating properly. Recognize and appropriately escalate suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, or other security concerns. Maintain clear records of troubleshooting, equipment, network changes, installations, and resolutions. Required Qualifications Current CompTIA A+ certification required. 1–2+ years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, network support, or similar experience preferred. Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11. Experience troubleshooting computers, hardware, printers, and peripherals. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365. Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IPv4, DHCP, DNS, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, managed switches, and VLANs. Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and research solutions. Strong communication and customer-service skills. Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical employees. Ability to provide both remote and onsite support. Ability to travel to company offices and client locations as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required : CompTIA Network+ or Security+ Microsoft technical certifications TP-Link Omada or similar managed networking platforms Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Intune or other endpoint-management platforms Microsoft 365 administration Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools Structured cabling and network racks Multi-location IT environments Basic Azure or cloud infrastructure What We're Looking For Technical knowledge is important, but how you approach problems matters just as much . We're looking for someone who takes ownership of issues, asks good questions, researches unfamiliar problems, tests potential solutions, and follows through until the problem is resolved. Hands-on experience counts. Candidates who have built home labs, worked on networking projects, built computers, experimented with virtualization or cloud environments, or pursued other technical projects are encouraged to tell us about them. You don't need to know everything. You do need to be willing and able to figure things out.

Solid foundation in Linux/Unix system administration and networking principles, paired with proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or Go. Practical experience with monitoring and observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) and a strong understanding of infrastructure security and compliance frameworks. This role is ideal for an engineer passionate about robotics, algorithm development, and system integration. You will work on planning, real-time decision making and implement features such as multi-floor navigation and docking control systems. You will also work with other engineers to develop robust testing pipelines, aimed at ensuring quality and reliability of our robots. Key Responsibilities You will own independent deliverables, collaborate closely with SLAM and Perception engineers, and play a critical role in shaping the next generation of autonomous systems. Key responsibilities include: Design and implement modular behavior tree architectures for complex and robust robot decision-making. Develop and optimize global planning algorithms (A*, D*, RRT*, PRM, etc.) for dynamic environments. Design and tune local planners and controllers for smooth and safe robot motion (e.g. MPC, TEB, DWA) Optimize planning and control systems to ensure real-time system performance, including timing guarantees for control loops. Collaborate with SLAM and Perception engineers to align navigation with perception, mapping. Develop comprehensive test cases for validating algorithms and software in both simulated and real-world environments, to ensure reliable performance. Maintain comprehensive documentation of all code implementations and test cases Explore advanced planning and control methods for real-world deployment (e.g., reinforcement learning-based planning) Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS, Robotics, or a related field (or PhD with relevant focus) Fresh graduate are welcome to apply Proficient in C++ and Python development on Linux. Experience working with ROS1 / ROS2. Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, kinematics, dynamics, and control theory Strong understanding of robot dynamics, kinematics, and control theory. Hands-on experience with behavior planning frameworks (e.g. BehaviorTree.CPP). Strong understanding of global and local path planning algorithms. Familiarity with sensor modalities (e.g. LiDAR, RGBD cameras, IMUs) Strong attention to detail, with excellent problem-solving and debugging skills Experience with reinforcement learning applied to behavior, planning or control is a bonus. Experience with optimizing software for embedded hardware (e.g., Jetson, ARM) is a bonus. If you have a passion for driving meaningful operational improvements, excel at analytical problem-solving, and thrive in a dynamic scaleup atmosphere, we invite you to join LionsBot and help shape the future of robotics innovation.

Change.org is the world’s largest platform for democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy globally is at an all-time high, we’re investing heavily in using AI to build an operating system for modern democracy. This includes our platform for giving people greater voice, a personalized voter guide for elections, and a new product which aims to bring people across the political spectrum together to identify shared solutions. To realize this vision, we're building a team at the intersection of technology and civic engagement — bringing together top talent focused on giving citizens a direct voice, strengthening accountability, and building stronger, more resilient democracies. Key Outcomes Develop and communicate an AI strategy that has wide alignment and support across the organization. Build and maintain an iterative roadmap of AI transformation initiatives across and within our teams. Develop a robust AI learning program, including regular ‘step change’ training and frequent AI demos relevant to each team. Infuse the organization with frequent insights into developments in AI relevant to each team, and push all of us to grasp what’s already possible, or coming soon. Own the AI transformation operating cadence — run the meeting rhythm and reporting forums (AI-Exec, AI-PD, and related working groups) that keep teams aligned on sequencing and dependencies. Come in with ‘big ears’ and proactively listen to ICs on the ground before recommending major changes — map what’s actually happening versus what leadership believes is happening, and deliver candid recommendations on where AI adoption stands and should be going. Analyse Financières Collecter d’information financière, économique etc ; Analyser et Evaluer : Rentabilité, Résultats, Prévisions etc ; Identifier les impacts financiers / Niveau de Risques / Perspectives de Développement ; Produire, préparer et présenter les recommandations détaillées 🏆 Et si on parlait de vous ? (Idéalement VBA, Power Automate etc.) ; Vous savez analyser et formaliser des processus et avez une appétence pour la conduite de projets de transformation / conduite dans le changement ; Vous avez de fortes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse et d’excellentes qualités relationnelles ; Vous êtes doté/dotée d’autonomie, du sens des responsabilités de rigueur et d’organisation Vous avez un esprit d'initiative et êtes orienté/orientée résultats. Vous avez de fortes capacités à travailler dans un environnement multiculturel. Et le process ? Un 1er entretien avec une personne de l’équipe RH + 1 entretien avec le Directeur Financier du siège basé à Issy-les-Moulineaux + 1 entretien avec le DAF CANAL+ Congo et CANAL+ Telecom Congo basé à Brazzaville, environ 3 semaines en tout, en visio ou en physique ! En tant que média, producteur et distributeur de contenus, le Groupe CANAL+ a une responsabilité particulière. En interne ou à l’écran, nous soutenons une création ambitieuse, inclusive et respectueuse des limites planétaires. 👊 On agit pour l’égalité entre les femmes et les hommes, contre toute forme de discrimination ou harcèlement 🤝 On agit pour l’égalité des chances et l’inclusion de tous et toutes 🌍 On agit pour réduire notre impact environnemental et éco-concevoir nos produits Si vous voyez cette annonce, c’est que vous avez votre chance et que nous n’avons pas encore trouvé la perle rare ! 👉 Seulement chez CANAL+ Congo basé à Brazzaville en contrat V.I.E !

review_candidates.title: Traffic Management Specialist
review_candidates.description: The Traffic Management Specialist arranges the shipment of Global Prepositioned Material Services (GPMS) cargo to various worldwide destinations via air, land and sea. The Incumbent must comply with all applicable International and Federal Transportation Laws, Regulations, Tariffs and Department of Defense (DOD) guidance. Must be able to gain access to Logistics Tool Suite (LTS), Global Freight Management (GRM), Cargo Movement Operating System (CMOS), Integrated Logistics System-Supply (ILS-S), Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES), Integrated Computerized Deployment System (ICODES), Integrated Booking System (IBS), Joint Container Management system (JCM), Wood Packaging Materials (WPM) Management Toolset, Global Asset Reporting Tool (GART) and web-based tracking systems such as Integrated Data Environment/Global Transportation Network Convergence (IGC), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID-ITV) Tracking Portal, Global Decision Support Systems (GDSS-2) and Single Mobility System (SMS) to ensure In-transit Visibility (ITV) within the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Ensures all shipments comply with the International Trade and Arms Regulations (ITAR), the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Must be able to complete AMMO-43, Intermodal Dry Cargo Container/CSC Reinspection, AMMO-62, Technical Transportation of Hazardous Materials Distance Learning Courses and WPM certification/recertification web-based training. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Principal Accountabilities Inspects, accepts documentation (DD Form 1149/1348-1), prepares and processes all outbound/inbound cargo offered for transportation in the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Checks for completeness and accuracy. Verifies the Nomenclatures, Quantity, Transportation Control Numbers (TCN), Transportation Account Code (TAC), Consignor and Consignee Codes, Hazardous/Classified materials, ITARS certifications and other essential transportation data. Properly classified freight, selects commodity codes, selects the most efficient mode of shipment and controls obligations for government transportation funds. Prepares all required shipping documents for data input to CMOS/GATES, assigns Transportation Control Numbers, produces labels, issues truck manifest for general/hazardous cargo and Maintains Manifest logs. Uses automated computer systems to process and document to accurately input the Transportation Control Numbers, Transportation Accounting Codes, consignor and consignee codes and other essential transportation data into CMOS, GATES or IBS. Inspects Hazardous Materials to ensure proper packaging, marking, labeling, documentation and certification in accordance with applicable Dangerous Goods Regulations (AFMAN 24-604, 49 Code of Federal Regulation, International Air Transport Association (IATA) and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG). Inspects, accepts and inventories all incoming freight and containers for overages, shortages and damage before acceptance. When required, initiate and complete DD Form 361, Transportation Discrepancy Report (TDR). Provides asset visibility and real-time view to track customer queries using IGC, RFID-ITV, GDSS2 or SMS. Prepares shipping documents and Movement Requests for international and domestic shipments between sites and container movements from the Sea Port of Embarkation (POE) to the Sea Port of Debarkation (POD) shipped by surface or sealift. Performs Port Handling and Inland Transportation (PHIT) and ensures the subcontractor performs all duties and responsibilities according to the Statement of Work (SOW). Inspects and documents each shipment for contract compliance on a Customer Service Survey form. Processes Export Traffic Release Requests (ETRR) for sealift shipments using Surface Deployment Distribution Command (SDDC) - Integrated Booking System (IBS). Performs Host Country customs clearances and liaises with Military and Host country Ministries on Import and Export for Border Customs Clearances, Airport Customs Clearances and Seaport Clearances. Selects and initiates contact with local carriers to arrange appropriate transport equipment for containers, classified, sensitive, hazardous or outsized shipments based on the size, weight, commodity description, freight classification, required delivery date, priority or other special requirements. Loads/unloads 463L pallets, equipment, vehicles and ISO containers from flat-bed/low-bed trucks. May assist in loading/unloading military vessels at the seaport. Assists the Pallet and Net Managers with inspections, issuing, accounting, controlling, reporting and maintaining operation stock levels of 463L pallets, nets and other tie-down equipment located on-site. Assists the WPM Custodian with inspecting and certification, record keeping and reporting the receipt and usage requirements. Assists the CCO with completing the monthly container inventory, ensuring all containers located on-site are inventoried between the 1st and 30th day of each month. Reports all lost, damaged, destroyed and modified containers to the CCO within 12 hours of discovery. Performs container inspections and reports findings on the DA 2404 equipment inspection and maintenance worksheet. Receives/Ships all containers in JCM within 12 hours of receipt or departure. Operates GATES and ICODES to process and manifest cargo and to develop load plans for military and commercial aircraft. Prepares, inspects, reviews and submits Preload Plans, Hazardous Materials Diplomatic Clearances (HAZDIP) and other documents to facilitate air movement. Inspects cargo documentation, conducts Joint Inspections and certifies that cargo is built correctly and airworthy. Computes weight and balance and certifies weight distribution of the aircraft with passengers, cargo and baggage. Determines cargo configuration and aircraft loading requirements in accordance with Air Transportability Test Loading Activity Certifications (ATTLA). Loads, unloads and services aircraft. Ensure cargo loads are secure and tied down. Assists load team chief with selecting, assembling, palletizing and transporting cargo loads to and from aircraft and storage areas. Safely transports and handles explosives. Performs passenger service procedures, check-in, manifest passengers and baggage and perform security checks. Loads/unloads passengers and baggage from aircraft. Performs weighing of cargo, vehicles and outsized cargo to determine the center of balance for rolling stock and ensures cargo dimensions are within pallet and aircraft limitations. Implements, documents and controls quality, training, environment and safety programs. Prepares and handles cargo in accordance with all prescribed regulations, instructions, technical orders and procedures. Accomplishes receiving process for all inbound cargo functions of MILSTRIP and NON-MILSTRIP shipments addressed to the host installation SRAN IAW with regulation. Maintains Technical Orders, publications, forms and files required for Traffic Management operations. Compiles data and submits reports and other correspondence as required. Performs other duties as assigned. Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods. Minimum Requirements Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum PowerPoint, Excel and Word programs. Knowledge of related shipping/receiving procedures and the ability to detect/report problems to appropriate personnel. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to effectively work under pressure and strict timelines required. Ability to maintain an effective working relationship with coworkers, including multi-national staff and external and internal customers is required. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing to coworkers and customers while maintaining Communication Security (COMSEC), Operational Security (OPSEC) and Computer Security (COMPUSEC). Knowledge and understanding of MHE equipment operations and associated hazards required. Will be required to receive training and operate material handling equipment. Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license. High School diploma or equivalent required. Minimum of three years of experience in Traffic Management (TMO)/Air Freight operations or associate degree in a related field of study required. Experience may include but is not limited to import/export, freight acceptance, preparation, handling, cargo shipping/receiving by surface, sea and air data records, container management, customer service, cargo operating computer systems or other related experience. Possess a current HAZMAT Certification in accordance with AFMAN 24-604 or ability to obtain it upon acceptance of the position. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location. Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed. Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs. Ability to travel domestically and internationally. Preferred Qualifications Experienced in aircraft cargo loading/unloading and cargo tie-down restraint procedures, palletizing cargo on single or multiple 463L pallets using side and top nets, straps, chains and devices for restraint preferred. Familiarization and certification in AMC Airlift Load Planning, or equivalent, and Joint Inspection process is preferred.

review_candidates.title: Track Engineer (Design), Dammam
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a Track Design Engineer with a solid design background to extend PMC services for a major client in Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on leading and assuring track alignment design for rail projects, aligning multidisciplinary interfaces, and driving delivery to client standards. Responsibilities Support the Engineering Lead to review horizontal and vertical alignment design for mainline, depot, and yard tracks using industry-standard tools (e.g., Bentley OpenRail, Civil 3D, MX). Define and enforce geometric design criteria, alignment control parameters, and tolerances across project phases (concept, preliminary, detailed design). Conduct design checks, optioneering, and value engineering for alignments, turnouts, crossovers, and transition curves to optimize performance, maintainability, and cost. Ensure compliance with international and regional rail standards and client-specific requirements, integrating RAMS, maintainability, and ride quality considerations. Act as the integrated PMC representative to the client, coordinating multi-disciplinary interfaces (civil, structures, trackwork, OCS, signaling, drainage, utilities). Manage technical queries, change requests, and design approvals, maintaining clear audit trails and configuration control. Lead design risk management for alignment choices, including ground conditions, utilities, third-party constraints, and environmental factors. Oversee contractor and designer performance on alignment deliverables, ensuring baseline schedule and quality adherence. Maintain design schedules, registers, and progress reporting for alignment-related works. Prepare and present technical reports, design review comments, and decision logs to client stakeholders. Ensure constructability and staging are embedded in alignment design, supporting site teams during construction and responding to RFIs. Implement robust quality assurance processes, including independent design reviews and verification/validation activities. Align deliverables with KSA authority requirements and applicable standards; support permitting and approvals. Engage with stakeholders, authorities, and third parties to resolve constraints, protect corridors, and secure approvals. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline; Master’s preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in railway track alignment and geometric design, including significant involvement in major rail programs. Proven experience in the KSA or GCC on rail design projects is strongly preferred; familiarity with KSA standards and authority processes is an advantage. Proficiency with rail alignment and civil design software (e.g., OpenRail/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, MX, PowerRail Track) and with model/drawing production workflows (BIM preferred). Solid knowledge of track geometry principles (UIC/EN/AREMA as applicable), turnouts and special trackwork, transition curves, cant and cant deficiency, and alignment constraints in urban and high-speed/metro environments. Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary interfaces and performing PMC/consultancy functions with clients. Strong communication, report writing, and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead technical meetings and drive decisions. Experience with quality systems, risk management, and configuration control for design packages.

review_candidates.title: Senior Experienced Hire, Rapid Value & Cash
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. As a pioneer in business strategy since 1963, BCG today helps clients drive total transformation – delivering rapid, tangible results alongside long-term change. Within our Transform practice, our Rapid Value & Cash (RVC) offering focuses on high-impact levers to unlock immediate value, particularly for private equity portfolio companies and mid-cap organizations. We combine hands-on execution, senior operational expertise, and AI-enabled delivery to accelerate outcomes and drive measurable performance improvement. Practice Area Business Transformation is essential to adapt to ever-changing conditions—even for companies that are already dominating their markets. It’s a big challenge, but BCG’s business transformation consultants can help clients put the odds in their favor. BCG helps companies orchestrate an effective business transformation and turnaround when all signs point to the need for fast, focused action and when companies are grappling with an urgent need to change amid great disruption. We deliver immediate impact to each client’s bottom line, cash flow, and top-line growth—all while concentrating on what the client must do to sustain successful change far into the future. In addition, our special situation services help companies focus on managing their liquidity and capital. The goal? To strengthen their balance sheets, boost cash flows, and transition out of survival mode. What You'll Do Rapid Value & Cash (RVC) by BCG is a new enterprise within BCG; it is a natural extension of BCG Transform Practice Area but is designed to unlock untapped transformation opportunities with greater speed, flexibility, and lower setup risk. RVC teams work side-by-side with clients to rapidly diagnose issues and implement solutions across finance, HR, operations, supply chain, and technology. By embedding experienced operators and leveraging GenAI and forward-deployed engineers, we help organizations free up cash, optimize cost structures, and strengthen performance at pace – delivering results in weeks, not months, and enabling teams to stay focused on the most critical value drivers. As a Senior Operator in RVC, you will take on a hands-on execution role in high-stakes transformation and performance improvement situations. Depending on project mix, this may include stepping into interim leadership positions (CxO-1 / CxO-2) within client organizations, with clear accountability for on-site results. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, taking ownership of outcomes, driving decisions, and delivering rapid, measurable impact in execution-first environments. Lead high-impact workstreams and programs in turnaround, restructuring, and value creation – from diagnosis through implementation At times, take end-to-end ownership of results, including P&L impact, cash delivery, and operational performance improvements – in an interim leadership capacity within client organizations Translate analyses into pragmatic action plans and drive execution on-site to deliver measurable business impact at pace Execute across key value levers (cost, cash, operations, organization), with a strong focus on speed and impact Partner with senior stakeholders (CEO, CFO, functional leaders) to shape decisions, drive alignment, and navigate complex transformation settings Embed within client organizations and mobilize BCG’s full ecosystem (experts, proprietary tools, AI-enabled capabilities) to deliver end-to-end impact Build trusted client relationships, identify additional value creation opportunities, and support business development efforts Coach and develop team members and help build sustainable capabilities within client organizations Contribute to the evolution of RVC methodologies, playbooks, and best practices What You'll Bring 12–20+ years of relevant experience in consulting, private equity value creation, restructuring, or senior industry roles, with a strong track record in transformation and performance improvement Experience in interim or operational leadership roles with hands-on accountability is a plus; above all, a strong track record of owning outcomes and driving measurable results Deep functional and/or industry expertise (e.g., operations, finance, treasury, PMO, people, or organizational transformation), with the ability to apply it in complex, real-world settings Proven experience delivering turnarounds, restructuring programs, or large-scale value creation initiatives with measurable impact Strong execution mindset with the ability to move from analysis to action – bringing a hands-on, pragmatic, and results-oriented approach Credibility and presence to influence senior stakeholders (CEO, CFO, functional leaders) in demanding, fast-paced environments Experience in private equity-backed businesses, mid-cap companies, or industrial environments; interim or on-the-ground leadership experience is a plus Commercial acumen and relationship-building skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and contribute to client development Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with sound judgment to balance strategic perspective and practical execution Demonstrated leadership and team development skills, with a commitment to coaching and capability building Fluent in German and English (written and spoken) Career Opportunity: We are committed to your growth. As a Senior Experienced Hire in Rapid Value & Cash (RVC) by BCG, you will have the opportunity to shape a fast-growing capability at the intersection of strategy and execution, working on some of the most critical situations our clients face. You will have access to BCG’s global expert network, leading knowledge resources, best practices, and training opportunities, while building a distinctive profile in value creation, restructuring, and transformation delivery. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. review_candidates.title: Senior Design Manager
review_candidates.description: Build Your Career at FCC Canada FCC is an international reference in engineering and infrastructure. Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas (“FCC”), headquartered in Spain, is the parent company of one of the world’s leading infrastructure and citizen services groups. With more than a century of history, our business portfolio is highly diversified. FCC’s core businesses are construction, environmental services, end-to-end water management, and the development of concessions for large infrastructure. FCC Construcción has been present in Canada for more than 25 years, involved in innovative subway infrastructure work, such as the Highway 407 stations and Northern Tunnels for the Toronto York Spadina Subway Line Expansion, as well as the construction, operation, and maintenance of the Fredericton Moncton Highway. We are experiencing exponential growth in our presence in Canada. In 1998, it was awarded for the construction, operation, and maintenance project for the Fredericton-Moncton Highway. In 2011, it was awarded a section of the Toronto-York Spadina Subway extension, the first modern subway infrastructure project in the city. This project was completed in 2018. Building your career at FCC Canada offers a unique opportunity to engage with some of the most ambitious infrastructure projects in the country. Our portfolio includes the extensive GO Rail Expansion-On Corridor Project, the Scarborough Subway Extension Stations, Rail, and Systems Project, and the transformative Pape Tunnel and Underground Stations section of the Ontario Line, all reinforcing FCC Construcción’s strong presence in the Canadian market. We are also excited to announce the Cross Fraser Partnership for the Fraser River Tunnel Project, a significant initiative that will enhance transportation throughout the Greater Vancouver Region. Join us at FCC Canada to be part of these groundbreaking projects and advance your career in a dynamic and innovative environment. Project Opportunity FCC Canada, in a 50/50 joint venture with Webuild Civil Works Inc., will deliver the Pape Tunnel and Underground Stations section of the Ontario Line. This includes the design, construction, supply, and operation of three kilometres of twin tunnels underneath Pape Avenue between the Gerrard tunnel portal and the Don Valley bridge, two underground stations (Pape and Cosburn), two tunnel portals, three emergency exit buildings, and a rail switch/crossover near Sammon Avenue. The Pape Station connection will interface with the Toronto Transit Commission Line 2 subway and related works. The project uses a Progressive Design-Build (PDB) model, allowing greater collaboration between the project owner and contractor. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the Engineering during construction scope, providing support to the linewide technical manager in all commercial, staff and contractual aspects. Develop and maintain comprehensive design management plans, procedures for the construction phase. Ensure strict compliance with contractual, safety, and regulatory requirements throughout all stages of the project, including design, integration, temporary works, and validation. Support construction schedule with timely review to ultimately obtain EOR approval to achieve consent to construct. Foster a collaborative and cohesive working environment across all project disciplines, ensuring seamless integration between design and construction teams, temporary works designers, and other stakeholders. Conduct thorough impact assessments of design changes on schedule, costs, requirements, and interfaces, providing expert recommendations to senior management and clients. Interface directly with project teams, stakeholders, and contractors to monitor design progress, track milestones, and manage interfaces between systems integration, testing, and commissioning. Oversee engineering ESDC scope in accordance with project procedures, ensuring documentation, reporting, and processes are consistently followed. Mentor and guide junior managers and engineers, promoting professional development and fostering a culture of excellence within the design and project teams. Education And Qualifications Minimum of 15-20 years of experience in design management, with a focus on large-scale underground stations or similar infrastructure projects. Extensive experience in managing the design processes for underground transit infrastructure, including underground and interchange stations. Proven experience in overseeing Engineering during construction scope (ESDC) within the technical teams. Strong understanding in managing ESDC technical team procedures through ACC or any other collaborative environment during the construction phase. Strong understanding managing Design changes during the construction phase through ESDC procedures and strong knowledge in ESDC related procedures such as RFI, Site instructions, Field request, NCRs, ITP. Strong understanding on management and delivery of record drawings, As-builds and Redlines. Strong understanding of industry standards, safety regulations, and environmental considerations related to underground station design. Experience working with the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) is highly desirable. Job Requirements: Demonstrated expertise in directing the complex underground station programs, from achieving IFC and Consent to construct through to construction, integration, and commissioning. Proven ability to provide strategic leadership to cross-functional and multi-organization teams, ensuring alignment between design, construction, systems integration, and regulatory ESDC frameworks. Skilled in managing and leading complex ESDC Construction submittals (drawings, specifications, interface agreements, technical reports) at a management level. Ability to pass pre-hire background and drug screening as required on the contract. Ability to obtain and maintain the required level clearance. U.S. Citizenship. Valid state driver’s license with acceptable driving record. Preferred Registered as a Professional Engineer in the state of New Mexico or the ability to receive reciprocity within the introductory period. Cross-discipline experience with mechanical and civil facility projects, building automation and control networks. Knowledge of the Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 and its application with regard to electrical requirements for facilities and distribution systems. Basic knowledge of communications systems, as well as Instrumentation & Control (I&C) is needed. PLC and Logic are not required but preferred. Demonstrated skill in the use of AutoCAD, SKM Power Tool, EST3-SDU and Fireworks is a plus. Experience working on a government contract or on a government Working Conditions: Desk/office work and test area work. Test area work may involve standing and directing technical personnel. Field work may be necessary. Travel to remote sites/locations may be required. Walking on uneven terrain including paved areas, gravel/rocks, and dirt/sand is required to access various locations on the facility. All work must be completed in a safe manner in accordance with NASA and Company safety standards. Work hours are subject to change, with weekend and/or holiday work as needed. This job may involve walking, standing, bending, reaching, and handling of items weighing up to 30 pounds. Work requires the ability to operate a computer, effectively communicate information in verbal and written form, read and review information. Position is located on a hazardous testing facility; must be able to quickly evacuate buildings in the event of an emergency. May be required to wear breathing protection (respirator), hearing protection, eye protection and other associated personal protective equipment. Un 1er entretien avec une personne de l’équipe RH + 1 entretien avec le Directeur Financier du siège basé à Issy-les-Moulineaux + 1 entretien avec le DAF CANAL+ Congo et CANAL+ Telecom Congo basé à Brazzaville, environ 3 semaines en tout, en visio ou en physique ! new_matches.title: Traffic Management Specialist
new_matches.description: The Traffic Management Specialist arranges the shipment of Global Prepositioned Material Services (GPMS) cargo to various worldwide destinations via air, land and sea. The Incumbent must comply with all applicable International and Federal Transportation Laws, Regulations, Tariffs and Department of Defense (DOD) guidance. Must be able to gain access to Logistics Tool Suite (LTS), Global Freight Management (GRM), Cargo Movement Operating System (CMOS), Integrated Logistics System-Supply (ILS-S), Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES), Integrated Computerized Deployment System (ICODES), Integrated Booking System (IBS), Joint Container Management system (JCM), Wood Packaging Materials (WPM) Management Toolset, Global Asset Reporting Tool (GART) and web-based tracking systems such as Integrated Data Environment/Global Transportation Network Convergence (IGC), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID-ITV) Tracking Portal, Global Decision Support Systems (GDSS-2) and Single Mobility System (SMS) to ensure In-transit Visibility (ITV) within the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Ensures all shipments comply with the International Trade and Arms Regulations (ITAR), the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Must be able to complete AMMO-43, Intermodal Dry Cargo Container/CSC Reinspection, AMMO-62, Technical Transportation of Hazardous Materials Distance Learning Courses and WPM certification/recertification web-based training. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS). Principal Accountabilities Inspects, accepts documentation (DD Form 1149/1348-1), prepares and processes all outbound/inbound cargo offered for transportation in the Defense Transportation System (DTS). Checks for completeness and accuracy. Verifies the Nomenclatures, Quantity, Transportation Control Numbers (TCN), Transportation Account Code (TAC), Consignor and Consignee Codes, Hazardous/Classified materials, ITARS certifications and other essential transportation data. Properly classified freight, selects commodity codes, selects the most efficient mode of shipment and controls obligations for government transportation funds. Prepares all required shipping documents for data input to CMOS/GATES, assigns Transportation Control Numbers, produces labels, issues truck manifest for general/hazardous cargo and Maintains Manifest logs. Uses automated computer systems to process and document to accurately input the Transportation Control Numbers, Transportation Accounting Codes, consignor and consignee codes and other essential transportation data into CMOS, GATES or IBS. Inspects Hazardous Materials to ensure proper packaging, marking, labeling, documentation and certification in accordance with applicable Dangerous Goods Regulations (AFMAN 24-604, 49 Code of Federal Regulation, International Air Transport Association (IATA) and International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG). Inspects, accepts and inventories all incoming freight and containers for overages, shortages and damage before acceptance. When required, initiate and complete DD Form 361, Transportation Discrepancy Report (TDR). Provides asset visibility and real-time view to track customer queries using IGC, RFID-ITV, GDSS2 or SMS. Prepares shipping documents and Movement Requests for international and domestic shipments between sites and container movements from the Sea Port of Embarkation (POE) to the Sea Port of Debarkation (POD) shipped by surface or sealift. Performs Port Handling and Inland Transportation (PHIT) and ensures the subcontractor performs all duties and responsibilities according to the Statement of Work (SOW). Inspects and documents each shipment for contract compliance on a Customer Service Survey form. Processes Export Traffic Release Requests (ETRR) for sealift shipments using Surface Deployment Distribution Command (SDDC) - Integrated Booking System (IBS). Performs Host Country customs clearances and liaises with Military and Host country Ministries on Import and Export for Border Customs Clearances, Airport Customs Clearances and Seaport Clearances. Selects and initiates contact with local carriers to arrange appropriate transport equipment for containers, classified, sensitive, hazardous or outsized shipments based on the size, weight, commodity description, freight classification, required delivery date, priority or other special requirements. Loads/unloads 463L pallets, equipment, vehicles and ISO containers from flat-bed/low-bed trucks. May assist in loading/unloading military vessels at the seaport. Assists the Pallet and Net Managers with inspections, issuing, accounting, controlling, reporting and maintaining operation stock levels of 463L pallets, nets and other tie-down equipment located on-site. Assists the WPM Custodian with inspecting and certification, record keeping and reporting the receipt and usage requirements. Assists the CCO with completing the monthly container inventory, ensuring all containers located on-site are inventoried between the 1st and 30th day of each month. Reports all lost, damaged, destroyed and modified containers to the CCO within 12 hours of discovery. Performs container inspections and reports findings on the DA 2404 equipment inspection and maintenance worksheet. Receives/Ships all containers in JCM within 12 hours of receipt or departure. Operates GATES and ICODES to process and manifest cargo and to develop load plans for military and commercial aircraft. Prepares, inspects, reviews and submits Preload Plans, Hazardous Materials Diplomatic Clearances (HAZDIP) and other documents to facilitate air movement. Inspects cargo documentation, conducts Joint Inspections and certifies that cargo is built correctly and airworthy. Computes weight and balance and certifies weight distribution of the aircraft with passengers, cargo and baggage. Determines cargo configuration and aircraft loading requirements in accordance with Air Transportability Test Loading Activity Certifications (ATTLA). Loads, unloads and services aircraft. Ensure cargo loads are secure and tied down. Assists load team chief with selecting, assembling, palletizing and transporting cargo loads to and from aircraft and storage areas. Safely transports and handles explosives. Performs passenger service procedures, check-in, manifest passengers and baggage and perform security checks. Loads/unloads passengers and baggage from aircraft. Performs weighing of cargo, vehicles and outsized cargo to determine the center of balance for rolling stock and ensures cargo dimensions are within pallet and aircraft limitations. Implements, documents and controls quality, training, environment and safety programs. Prepares and handles cargo in accordance with all prescribed regulations, instructions, technical orders and procedures. Accomplishes receiving process for all inbound cargo functions of MILSTRIP and NON-MILSTRIP shipments addressed to the host installation SRAN IAW with regulation. Maintains Technical Orders, publications, forms and files required for Traffic Management operations. Compiles data and submits reports and other correspondence as required. Performs other duties as assigned. Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods. Minimum Requirements Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum PowerPoint, Excel and Word programs. Knowledge of related shipping/receiving procedures and the ability to detect/report problems to appropriate personnel. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to effectively work under pressure and strict timelines required. Ability to maintain an effective working relationship with coworkers, including multi-national staff and external and internal customers is required. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing to coworkers and customers while maintaining Communication Security (COMSEC), Operational Security (OPSEC) and Computer Security (COMPUSEC). Knowledge and understanding of MHE equipment operations and associated hazards required. Will be required to receive training and operate material handling equipment. Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license. High School diploma or equivalent required. Minimum of three years of experience in Traffic Management (TMO)/Air Freight operations or associate degree in a related field of study required. Experience may include but is not limited to import/export, freight acceptance, preparation, handling, cargo shipping/receiving by surface, sea and air data records, container management, customer service, cargo operating computer systems or other related experience. Possess a current HAZMAT Certification in accordance with AFMAN 24-604 or ability to obtain it upon acceptance of the position. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location. Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed. Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs. Ability to travel domestically and internationally. Preferred Qualifications Experienced in aircraft cargo loading/unloading and cargo tie-down restraint procedures, palletizing cargo on single or multiple 463L pallets using side and top nets, straps, chains and devices for restraint preferred. Familiarization and certification in AMC Airlift Load Planning, or equivalent, and Joint Inspection process is preferred.

new_matches.title: Track Engineer (Design), Dammam
new_matches.description: We are seeking a Track Design Engineer with a solid design background to extend PMC services for a major client in Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on leading and assuring track alignment design for rail projects, aligning multidisciplinary interfaces, and driving delivery to client standards. Responsibilities Support the Engineering Lead to review horizontal and vertical alignment design for mainline, depot, and yard tracks using industry-standard tools (e.g., Bentley OpenRail, Civil 3D, MX). Define and enforce geometric design criteria, alignment control parameters, and tolerances across project phases (concept, preliminary, detailed design). Conduct design checks, optioneering, and value engineering for alignments, turnouts, crossovers, and transition curves to optimize performance, maintainability, and cost. Ensure compliance with international and regional rail standards and client-specific requirements, integrating RAMS, maintainability, and ride quality considerations. Act as the integrated PMC representative to the client, coordinating multi-disciplinary interfaces (civil, structures, trackwork, OCS, signaling, drainage, utilities). Manage technical queries, change requests, and design approvals, maintaining clear audit trails and configuration control. Lead design risk management for alignment choices, including ground conditions, utilities, third-party constraints, and environmental factors. Oversee contractor and designer performance on alignment deliverables, ensuring baseline schedule and quality adherence. Maintain design schedules, registers, and progress reporting for alignment-related works. Prepare and present technical reports, design review comments, and decision logs to client stakeholders. Ensure constructability and staging are embedded in alignment design, supporting site teams during construction and responding to RFIs. Implement robust quality assurance processes, including independent design reviews and verification/validation activities. Align deliverables with KSA authority requirements and applicable standards; support permitting and approvals. Engage with stakeholders, authorities, and third parties to resolve constraints, protect corridors, and secure approvals. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline; Master’s preferred. Minimum 10 years of experience in railway track alignment and geometric design, including significant involvement in major rail programs. Proven experience in the KSA or GCC on rail design projects is strongly preferred; familiarity with KSA standards and authority processes is an advantage. Proficiency with rail alignment and civil design software (e.g., OpenRail/OpenRoads, Civil 3D, MX, PowerRail Track) and with model/drawing production workflows (BIM preferred). Solid knowledge of track geometry principles (UIC/EN/AREMA as applicable), turnouts and special trackwork, transition curves, cant and cant deficiency, and alignment constraints in urban and high-speed/metro environments. Demonstrated experience managing multidisciplinary interfaces and performing PMC/consultancy functions with clients. Strong communication, report writing, and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead technical meetings and drive decisions.
